plugin.name: Netdisk
plugin.description: Browse your Medeo Drive folders: store files by dragging them in, take them out by dragging them to Finder, rename, delete and see each file's sync state.
signed_out_note: Sign in from the Medeo icon in the menu bar, then come back here.
unsupported_title: Not available on this computer yet
unsupported_note: Netdisk needs Medeo Drive on macOS.
unavailable_title: Medeo Drive is not available right now
pick_note: Netdisk only sees the folders you allow. You can add more at any time.
no_folders: Add a synced folder in Medeo first (menu bar icon → Add folder).
reason: Show Netdisk your folder so you can store and take out files
empty: This folder is empty. Drag files here to store them.
name_taken: An item with that name already exists.
r_file_in_use: The file is open in another app
r_too_large: Larger than the file size limit
r_invalid_name: The name has characters the cloud does not accept
r_permission_denied: No permission to read the file
onb_title: Choose the Medeo Drive folders to manage here
onb_note: These are the folders you sync with Medeo Drive. Once added you can browse, store, take out and organize their files.
subfolder_q: Only need a folder inside one?
all_added: Every Medeo Drive folder is already here. Add new synced folders from the Medeo menu bar icon.
empty_note: Drag files here to store them in Medeo Drive, or
drop_note: {n} file(s) · a taken name keeps both
banner_cloud: {n} file(s) are only in the cloud; they download before opening or taking out
will_confirm: Medeo asks you to confirm each
e_drive_outside_folders: That folder is not in Medeo Drive. Choose a synced folder ({folders}) or a folder inside one; add other folders as synced folders from the Medeo menu bar icon first.
e_drive_no_folders: Medeo Drive has no synced folders yet. Add one from the Medeo menu bar icon.
e_drive_signed_out: Sign in to Medeo Drive first.
e_drive_unavailable: Medeo Drive is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
e_drive_folder_not_found: That folder is no longer synced by Medeo Drive.
e_permission_denied: Netdisk is not allowed to do that. Check its permissions in the plugin center.
e_source_missing: That file is no longer available to store. Drag it in again.
e_resource_quota: Too many folders are allowed already. Remove one from the sidebar first.
e_export_failed: Could not take the file out there.
e_native_tray_unavailable: Medeo is not running in the menu bar.
info_hint: Select a file to see its details.
